text: Token-plutocracy is the default governance form: across all forty DAOs governance is fundamentally token-weighted, even the strongest formal processes recreate capital-based concentration beneath the procedural facade, and no DAO has implemented reputation-weighted voting in production.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Institutional Deficit in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations - An Empirical Analysis (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6819121

isBasedOn.name: The Institutional Deficit in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations - An Empirical Analysis

abstract: Even DAOs with the strongest formal governance processes, BanklessDAO at 8/10 on Governance, ENS at 8/10, operate underlying token-weighted voting that recreates capital-based concentration beneath the procedural facade. No DAO in the dataset has implemented reputation-weighted voting in production.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: forty operational DAOs against the thirteen-category rubric
